summary.en-US: A mod to make Traumasoft mobile-friendly. Post-Traumatic puts the most-used options directly in the top bar and restructures the schedule, work order, checklist, and punch clock pages for dramatically increased usability.

description.en-US: A mod to make Traumasoft mobile-friendly. Works with Safari on iPhone or Firefox on Android. Post-Traumatic puts the most-used options directly in the top bar and restructures the schedule, work order, checklist, and punch clock pages for dramatically increased usability. It also lets the log-in page remember your username after the first time it's typed. The rest of the site is unchanged.

release_notes.en-US: Renamed to Post-Traumatic. Schedule page split into Schedule and More Options tabs. Quick bar in the header (schedule, work orders, checklists, punch clock); work order forms and BLS/ALS checklists restyled for phones; odometer accepts any reading above the last. Header Punch button and a one-button punch clock page that asks before an early punch. Login page: the username you last signed in with is filled in. Individual Month View: each shift shows who is on the unit with you or that the seat is open, with a See spares list of others working those hours without a partner. Calendar button beside Find a person: a month grid of that person's shifts; tap a day for unit, hours and crewmates. View picker split into Common and Other; changing the view, month or year reloads immediately.
